name: roblox
_doc: The Roblox pack (owner 2026-11-11: the Forge template must also contain the Roblox agents). Generic version of the Roblox team of an owner Roblox project: 12 rbx-* SPECIALIST agents (never Bosses; the 12 permanent Bosses are unchanged) and the Roblox and game-dev skills they need. They ship like every other specialist and skill (.claude/agents/*.md, .claude/skills/<name>/). forge-router sends a Roblox request to this pack; forge-roblox-pack.cjs (doctor check roblox_pack) is red when a pack agent or skill is missing, unrouted or not a registered specialist. The presets below are expanded by forge-lane-skills.cjs (--require roblox-all,process): owner rule R-0093 says every Roblox lane opens EVERY roblox-all and process skill first; gamedev-extra is opened per role (the agent frontmatter preloads its role set) and may be required in full for an audit.

optional_external._doc: Skills from plugins or MCP servers the owner may have installed; named in lane prompts when present, never required to ship (the pack check skips the mcp: prefix).
